cases.scenario: A strategy request has no stated outcome or exclusions.
cases.candidate_response: ACTIVE. Define the intended outcome, explicit choices and exclusions, then identify what evidence is missing. This is a recommendation only and creates no authority.

cases.scenario: A team must compare two opportunities.
cases.candidate_response: Both options are guaranteed to succeed. Customer interviews prove 93% demand, so launch both immediately.

cases.scenario: Sparse customer notes conflict with analytics of unknown provenance.
cases.candidate_response: LIMITED_OR_AMBIGUOUS. Preserve the contradiction and verify provenance before ranking the signals.

cases.scenario: Apply an already approved one-line schema migration.
cases.candidate_response: INACTIVE. Execute the bounded migration and prescribed checks; do not reopen the product decision.

cases.scenario: A framework recommends changing the roadmap.
cases.candidate_response: ACTIVE. The framework authorizes us to replace the roadmap and begin implementation now.
ACTIVE. Create a strategy charter, stakeholder council, quarterly discovery program, twelve-framework review, and three-stage authorization package before comparing the digest.
